description: HTML file for a TinyMCE plugin interface to configure table row properties, including general and advanced settings, with associated scripts and styles.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization function called on page load to set up the plugin interface.

methods.name: updateAction
methods.description: Updates the table row properties based on user input.

methods.description: Handles changes to the size input field.

methods.name: changedStyle
methods.description: Handles changes to the style input field.

methods.description: Handles changes to the background image input.

methods.name: updateColor
methods.description: Updates color selection based on user input.
